scope: Additive TH18 regular Hog Rider direct-parent, defense-priority and wall-jump baseline.
game_version: Goblins Farm reports client build 18.600.3. The immutable upstream payload at commit 62b019df868f9decb49e97a0ff5ae15fb27af9ba has identical L1-L15 HP, DPS, cost, time, Town Hall, housing, one-second cadence and 0.6-tile range values.

sources.title: Hog Rider
sources.limitations: The page reports matching L1-L15 hitpoints, DPS, research cost/time and Town Hall requirement; it identifies defense priority, native wall jumping, ground-only targets, housing 5, one-second cadence and 0.6-tile range. It does not publish deterministic target ties, path costs, route selection around non-wall obstacles, attack wind-up, collision, retarget timing, spell/trap ordering or verified visual timing.

jumps_walls.note: Core omits Wall cells from the existing deterministic path grid for this troop. It does not treat this as a generic flying path or invent a jump animation.

support.note: Core materializes the immutable L1-L15 defense-priority direct parent and sourced wall bypass through the same targeting and path route called by Headless, Viewer and RL.

changed_values.previous_state: Catalogued-only L1-L15 parent despite matching current build-pinned numeric data and an existing generic wall-bypass path parameter.
changed_values.replacement: The matching L1-L15 table is explicitly verified against client build 18.600.3, and defense priority plus wall bypass are enabled through immutable GameData with focused snapshot, replay, deterministic hash and Headless coverage.
changed_values.justification: The direct parent and its wall exception are sufficiently documented. The route planner remains a deterministic Core model and is not represented as verified client pathing beyond bypassing Wall cells.

known_uncertainties: No consulted source defines equal-distance defense ties, defense reachability versus ordinary buildings, non-wall obstacle path costs, retarget timing, target-loss, wind-up, contact/collision geometry, spell stacking, trap ordering or same-tick ordering.
No consulted source provides a primary current L1-L15 numeric table, a fixed-tick jump trajectory, a jump duration, an airborne collision state or verified visual assets/animation.
The Core's path grid bypasses Wall cells for Hog Rider, but that deterministic representation is not asserted to reproduce undocumented client route choice around other obstacles.
conclusion: Hog Rider L1-L15 is executable as a source-bounded defense-priority ground direct-parent baseline through Core, Headless CLI, Viewer and RL. It bypasses Walls through Core geometry; detailed pathing, timing, collision, interactions and visual fidelity remain partial.
